high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of the login screen for Grammarly's keyboard app. The background is dark, likely to reduce eye strain while typing. At the top, there is a header that reads "The Grammarly Keyboard" followed by the tagline "Mistake-free writing in all your apps." Below this, there are three prominent buttons for logging into the app: Continue with Facebook: This button features the Facebook logo and an arrow pointing to the right, indicating where to click to proceed. Continue with Google: This button has the Google logo and an arrow pointing to the right, suggesting the same action
